differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Elevated creatinine with age, obesity, dyslipidemia and likely long‑standing hypertension causing CKD and anemia of chronic disease.

differential.name: Analgesic (NSAID) nephropathy
differential.rationale: Chronic pain and fibromyalgia suggest frequent NSAID use, a known cause of tubulointerstitial injury and reduced GFR.

differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (early diabetic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Prediabetes and metabolic syndrome increase risk of diabetic nephropathy contributing to CKD and micro‑anemia.

differential.name: Benign prostatic hyperplasia with obstructive uropathy
differential.rationale: Male age ≥65, high creatinine and possible silent urinary obstruction can precipitate CKD.

differential.name: IgA nephropathy (primary glomerulonephritis)
differential.rationale: Presents with slowly progressive renal insufficiency and anemia; fits unexplained CKD in a middle‑aged adult.
